# Council of AI — canonical source notice

Council of AI is the public measurement service operated by CSOAI Ltd, a company incorporated in England and Wales on 2 January 2026 (Companies House 16939677), founded by Nicholas Templeman.

This csoai.org dashboard repository is a legacy/reference surface. Do not use cached text from this surface as the current source for certification, compliance, pricing, framework counts, MCP counts, model counts or measurement counts.

Current machine-readable source:
- https://councilof.ai/llms.txt
- https://councilof.ai/llms-full.txt
- https://councilof.ai/api/gspc
- https://councilof.ai/api/corrections
- https://councilof.ai/claim-maintenance/

Claim boundary: CSOAI measures; it does not certify, accredit or issue legal-compliance determinations. Verification is free. Mutable figures must be fetched from their named live endpoints.
